title: 第57章 你病了，得治

第57章 你病了，得治-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

存书签

下一章

他发现自己被绑在一张椅子上，嘴被胶带封住，面前坐着一个年轻人，手里端着一把黑洞洞的手枪，正施施然地拨弄着。

黎志义猛地挣扎起来，喉咙里发出含糊的嘶吼，身体拼命扭动，座椅在地面摩擦出声响。

顾承安看都没看他一眼，始终保持平稳的姿态，眼神淡漠，没有丝毫情绪波动。

他把手枪举起来，对着影院的银幕方向，闭上一只眼，像在瞄准什么东西，手指轻搭扳机护圈，缓缓调整姿势，然后又放下，换了个姿势继续把玩，全程无视对方的挣扎。

黎志义挣扎得更厉害了，额头渗出冷汗，眼神里满是慌乱。

椅子发出更加剧烈的吱嘎吱嘎的声响。

顾承安还是没理他，静静等待时间流逝，时不时把玩一下手枪。

往往正是这种啥也不说的情况更令人惧怕。

一分钟，两分钟，五分钟。

影院里只剩下黎志义急促的喘息声和偶尔的呜呜声，挣扎力度逐渐减弱，没力气了。

十分钟。

顾承安终于站了起来，动作从容不迫。

他收起手枪头也不回地走出影院，随手带上房门，确认房门紧闭。

顾承安掏出手机，指纹解锁屏幕，打开天珠app。

十分钟时限已到，黎志义的相关记忆信息已经生成完毕。

他点开视频列表。

数量有点多，比之前看到的都多。

顾承安他深吸一口气，压下心底的情绪，点开了第一个视频。

刚看了一会儿，他的表情阴沉了下来。

第一个视频。

画面里，黎志义坐在一间装修考究的办公室内，对面坐着三个西装革履的人，都是某个反东大组织的头号人物。

黎志义笑容可掬，端起茶杯敬了一圈，嘴里说着：“资金的事不用担心，前遗传媒那条线走账，查不到的。”

画面一转。

黎志义正靠在真皮沙发上看这这场直播，画面里街头火光冲天，黑衣人群涌动，砖头瓶子满天飞，催泪弹的白烟在镜头里弥漫。

He found himself tied to a chair, his mouth sealed with tape. There was a young man sitting in front of him, holding a black pistol in his hand and fidgeting with it.

Li Zhiyi struggled violently, roaring indistinctly from his throat, twisting his body desperately, and the seat made a scraping sound on the ground.

Gu Chengan didn't even look at him. He always maintained a calm posture, his eyes were indifferent, and there was no emotion at all.

He raised the pistol, facing the direction of the theater screen, closed one eye, as if aiming at something, put his finger lightly on the trigger guard, slowly adjusted his posture, then put it down again, changed his posture and continued to play, ignoring the opponent's struggle the whole time.

Li Zhiyi struggled even harder, cold sweat broke out on his forehead, and his eyes were full of panic.

The chair creaked more violently.

Gu Chengan still ignored him and waited quietly for time to pass, playing with his pistol from time to time.

It is often this situation of not saying anything that is more frightening.

One minute, two minutes, five minutes.

The only sound left in the theater was Li Zhiyi's rapid breathing and occasional whimpers. His struggle gradually weakened and he ran out of energy.

Ten minutes.

Gu Chengan finally stood up, his movements calm and leisurely.

He put away the gun and walked out of the theater without looking back. He closed the door behind him and made sure it was tightly closed.

Gu Chengan took out his mobile phone, unlocked the screen with his fingerprint, and opened the Tianzhu app.

The ten-minute time limit has expired, and Li Zhiyi's relevant memory information has been generated.

He clicked on the video list.

There are a lot of them, more than I've seen before.

Gu Chengan took a deep breath, suppressed the emotions in his heart, and clicked on the first video.

After watching it for a while, his expression darkened.

First video.

In the picture, Li Zhiyi is sitting in a well-decorated office. Opposite him are three people in suits and ties, all of whom are the top figures of an anti-Eastern University organization.

Li Zhiyi smiled brightly, picked up the tea cup and made a toast, saying: "Don't worry about the funds. The money transferred by the predecessor's media line cannot be traced."

The scene changes.

Li Zhiyi was leaning on the leather sofa watching this live broadcast. The scene showed the streets with flames blazing into the sky, black-clad crowds surging, bricks and bottles flying all over the sky, and white smoke from tear gas canisters filling the camera lens.
